description:
Take a structured snapshot of the edited scene: node paths, transforms, world bounds, fingerprints and counts, filtered by subtree, class or field. Returns snapshot_id, the baseline to diff after a change. Next: summer_snapshot_diff.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/world-snapshot"}

classes.description: Only nodes of these classes, e.g. ['MeshInstance3D', 'OmniLight3D'] (* wildcards allowed).

fields.description: Only these per-node fields (path is always kept): class, name, pos, rot_deg, scale, visible, aabb, scene_file, script_fp, material_fps, z_index, rect, view_rect, limit_rect.

max_nodes.description: Most node entries to return (default 200). The engine still snapshots the whole scene for the diff baseline; the result says when the list is cut (truncated, next_offset).

offset.description: Skip this many matching nodes (path-sorted) before listing — page with the result's next_offset.

path_prefix.description: Only this subtree: the node at this scene-relative path and everything below it, e.g. 'House3' or 'Lane2/Props'.

scene_path.description: Scene to snapshot, e.g. 'res://main.tscn'. Omit for the currently edited scene.

name: summer_world_snapshot
title: Take a scene snapshot
